Requirement: A user with valid credentials can log in and is taken to the products page.
Login is rejected with an error message when the username or password is incorrect.
Username and password are both required; an error is shown if either is empty.
A locked-out user cannot log in and sees a lock-out message.
Protected pages cannot be opened without being logged in.
The products page displays all products with image, name, description, price and an Add to cart button.
Clicking a product's image or title opens its details page.
The user can return to the products page from the details page.
The user can add an item to the cart from the products page.
The user can remove an item from the cart on the products page.
The user can add an item to the cart from the details page.
The user can remove an item from the cart on the details page.
Cart contents persist when the page is refreshed.
The cart icon shows a badge with the number of items, updating as items are added or removed.
Clicking the cart icon opens the cart page listing the items in the cart.
The user can return to the products page from the cart with 'Continue Shopping'.
The user can remove items from the cart page.
The user can start checkout from the cart page.
Checkout is not allowed when the cart is empty.
First name, last name and postal code are required before the user can continue.
The overview page shows the item total, tax and order total.
Clicking Finish completes the order and shows a confirmation.
The user can cancel checkout without losing the cart.
After an order, the user can return to the products page.
Products can be sorted by name (A-Z, Z-A) and by price (low-high, high-low).
The user can log out, which ends the session.
The user can reset the app state, which clears the cart.
